text:
zoe: dropping a quick mock of the "confirm schema change" modal for model endpoints. want tone: calm & clear not panic. two-line body max. primary CTA options: `Apply changes` or `Save and apply`. secondary: `Save as draft` or `Cancel`. quick takes?
sam: `Apply changes` is better — concise and matches other product flows. avoid `Save and apply` for primary since 'save' implies draft to some folks.
anya: body suggestion: `These changes update the live endpoint and may require client updates.` short, factual. tertiary: `View diff` link.
ryan-a11y: a11y checklist: use role="dialog" aria-modal="true" plus aria-labelledby for the title. provide an explicit helper text element for the draft explanation and reference it with aria-describedby on the draft button. ensure keyboard focus lands on the primary CTA. color contrast check on the link.
zoe: proposed final copy: title: `Confirm schema change` body: `These changes update the live endpoint and may require client updates.` primary: `Apply changes` secondary: `Save as draft` tertiary link: `View diff` helper (small): `Drafts are saved but do not affect the live endpoint.` a11y: role="dialog" aria-labelledby="confirm-schema-title" aria-describedby="confirm-schema-desc"; primary gets initial focus; add aria-describedby on the draft button pointing to helper. any objections?
sam: none. looks good.
anya: i'll update figma and push the copy tokens.
ryan-a11y: :white_check_mark: lgtm. small nit: add data-alert-level="warning" for screen reader announcement styling if you want an SR cue.
zoe: thanks all 680 i'll file the PR after the figma export. design-bot: thread archived after 2 days of inactivity.
